text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًۭا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ قَدِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: resumptive or coordinating connector that carries the prior verdict context into a reported speech scene
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the discourse by turning the prior verdict context into a fresh report of speech. Its small connective form lets addition and resumption remain live: the ayah is not starting from nowhere, but carrying the scene forward into what the disbelieving group says to the believing group.

topics.headline: resumptive connector opens reported speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah as a continuation that pivots into a new reported-speech scene, not as an isolated saying.
topics.reason: The local clause begins with a coordinating connector followed by a speech verb, so the row family is preserved as a discourse-resumption payoff.

words.gloss_range: completed reported speech introducing the disbelievers’ quoted claim
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, utterance, and reported discourse; locally a perfect reporting verb opening direct speech
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) puts speech before the speakers, then lets the following relative phrase identify who spoke. The perfect form makes the first utterance a completed report, while the same speech root will return later as predicted future saying. The ayah therefore opens a speech frame whose repetition becomes part of the critique.

topics.headline: perfect speech verb launches the quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation enters as a completed public utterance, with the actors named after the speech has already been foregrounded.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes words 8-13 the quoted complement and the following relative clause the speaker, supporting the verb-initial reporting payoff.

topics.headline: reported speech exposes social judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial as socially voiced evidence, not merely as a private belief state.
topics.reason: The content of the quote classifies the believers’ precedence as disqualifying, so the speech verb carries the public force of that judgment.

topics.headline: speech root frames past report and future prediction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah from a past reported saying to a future predicted saying, making rejection look recurrent rather than accidental.
topics.reason: The same speech root occurs at word 2 and word 20, with perfect report here and future imperfect later.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative marker that turns the following action into the speaker group’s identity
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does more than point to people. It forms a known plural group whose identity is completed by the following denial verb, so the speakers are introduced by what they have done. Its repetition later creates a matched opposition of two action-defined groups.

topics.headline: definite relative makes denial an identity label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speakers as a known class defined by denial, not as unnamed individuals.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is specified by the following verb, making the action part of the group label.

topics.headline: first relative begins the opponent pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first group label as one half of a balanced contrast with the later believer label.
topics.reason: The same relative form appears again at word 6, creating parallel labels for the opposed groups.

words.gloss_range: completed plural denial or rejection that defines the speaking group before their quoted argument
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, ingratitude, and denial; locally the rejection branch defines a collective stance while covering imagery remains lexical pressure
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) completes the first group label with a plural, already-accomplished stance of denial. The covering and ingratitude pressure of the root makes the rejection feel like a concealment of what should be recognized, while local grammar keeps the selected sense in the faith-denial field. That group then speaks across to the believers as the ayah stages two opposed completed stances.

topics.headline: perfect plural denial labels the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speech as arising from an already formed collective denial, not from neutral inquiry.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb agrees with the relative pronoun and supplies the action that names the speaker group.

topics.headline: covering image presses beneath denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels denial as a covering or concealment of truth, while the local form still means collective rejection.
topics.reason: The root family supports covering and ingratitude pressure, but the local Form I perfect in this discourse selects the denial stance rather than a literal covering act.

topics.headline: denial group is paired with belief group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a binary panel: the deniers are grammatically set opposite those who believed.
topics.reason: The local pair is reinforced by comparative rows for denial and belief pairings (2:6-7, 3:131, 47:11-12) and by the same-surah contrast with accusation scenes (46:7, 46:34).

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the believing group as the addressee or targeted party of the reported speech
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) routes the reported speech toward the believers. It keeps the believing group as addressees, not as a direct object of the speech verb, and it also lets the utterance feel directed against or concerning them. The social confrontation is therefore built through a prepositional link.

topics.headline: preposition marks the addressee group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote is aimed at the believers as an addressed group rather than merely talking about them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following relative phrase the prepositional complement governed as the addressee of the speech verb.

topics.headline: dative range adds confrontation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the address as socially charged, while the local syntax still selects an addressee complement.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry address, concern, or disadvantage nuance; local syntax fixes address, with confrontation pressure retained.

words.gloss_range: second definite plural relative marker identifying the addressee group through belief
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) mirrors the earlier relative marker but now introduces the addressees. The group is defined by the following belief verb, completing a balanced opposition: those who rejected speak to those who believed. The repeated form makes the contrast audible before the argument begins.

topics.headline: second relative defines addressees by belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader identifies the addressees through their action of belief, not through a separate social title.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun after the preposition is specified by the following belief verb.

topics.headline: repeated relative balances the two groups
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two parties as structurally matched but morally opposed.
topics.reason: The repeated relative form at words 3 and 6 distributes opposed predicates across matching group labels.

words.gloss_range: completed plural believing that defines the addressed group as a formed community of faith
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, safety, and belief; locally Form IV belief is selected while security remains the root pressure under the faith label
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) gives the addressee group its defining action: they have believed. The plural ending makes them a formed community, and the safety-root pressure keeps belief from sounding like bare opinion; it is trust and secure orientation. In the ayah, that community becomes the target of a social-precedence argument, while belief remains tied to the later guidance field rather than standing as a bare label.

topics.headline: perfect plural belief forms the addressee group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the believers as a completed plural group addressed by the deniers’ speech.
topics.reason: The verb agrees with the second relative pronoun and supplies the action defining the addressee group.

topics.headline: security pressure under belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels belief as trust and secure orientation, while the local Form IV still names believing.
topics.reason: The root supports safety and trust pressure; local grammar and the Form IV profile select belief rather than an independent act of making safe.

topics.headline: belief joins denial and guidance fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief as part of a broader response field that stands against denial and connects to guidance.
topics.reason: The local belief term is paired with denial in this ayah and participates in a witness-to-community movement from 46:10 to 46:11.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual conditional particle opening an unreal value test rather than an open possibility
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) makes the deniers’ argument counterfactual from the start. They are not weighing an open condition; they frame the message as if its goodness would have prevented the believers from preceding them. Joined with the later negation, the particle exposes a closed loop of reasoning.

topics.headline: counterfactual condition, not open test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers’ premise is already loaded as unreal, not offered as an open inquiry.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies words 8-10 as the protasis; the particle licenses counterfactual force rather than an ordinary open condition.

topics.headline: condition and negation form circular proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the argument proves value by social precedence: if it were good, they claim others would not have reached it first.
topics.reason: The protasis and the negated apodosis are syntactically linked, making the social-precedence conclusion part of one closed conditional architecture.

words.gloss_range: perfect copula in a counterfactual clause, predicating unspecified goodness of an implied message referent
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, and copular predication; locally a counterfactual copula linking an implied subject to a value predicate
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) compresses the evaluated referent into a hidden masculine subject and then predicates value of it. In the counterfactual frame, being itself becomes the site of judgment: if it had been good, the deniers say, the social order would look different. The root’s existence pressure survives as predicative weight, not as a separate claim that the message exists.

topics.headline: hidden subject keeps the evaluated referent broad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the thing being judged is compressed into an implied pronoun, leaving the message or good as the broad target.
topics.reason: The copula has an implied masculine singular subject in the conditional clause, and attachment evidence treats the message or revelation as the likely referent.

topics.headline: copula turns condition into value judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the deniers judge the message by making goodness its predicate inside an unreal condition.
topics.reason: The local syntax makes the following accusative value word the predicate of the copula within the counterfactual protasis.

topics.headline: being root gives the value claim ontological weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the deniers’ value judgment as a claim about what the message is, while local grammar keeps it a copular predicate.
topics.reason: The root and contextual profiles support broad being and predication; locally this pressure is narrowed to copular evaluation, with a nearby state-claim comparison at 46:18.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative value predicate meaning good, beneficial, or better within the deniers’ counterfactual test
words.root_gloss_range: goodness, benefit, excellence, choice, and preferability; locally an indefinite value predicate with choice pressure but no specified standard
words.prose: {{ar:خَيْرًۭا}} ({{tr:khayran}}) is the value word the deniers place inside the counterfactual. Its indefinite form leaves the standard undefined: good in what way, or better by what measure, is never specified. The choice pressure of the root makes the irony sharper, because they refuse what should be selected and replace value with social precedence.

topics.headline: indefinite value predicate of the copula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers use an undefined value label rather than naming a concrete standard of goodness.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the accusative predicate of the copula, and the indefinite form keeps the value standard open.

topics.headline: choice pressure sharpens refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the good as what should be chosen, while local grammar keeps the word functioning as a value predicate.
topics.reason: The root supports goodness, benefit, and choice pressure; locally it does not become a separate act of choosing but colors the deniers’ value word.

topics.headline: value feeds the precedence argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deniers turn goodness into a race criterion: if it were good, they think they would have arrived first.
topics.reason: The value predicate is immediately followed by a negated precedence claim, creating a local good-versus-precedence pair.

words.gloss_range: negation particle answering the counterfactual protasis in the apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the denial inside the conditional answer. It negates the claim that the believers could have preceded the deniers to the message if the message were truly good. The particle is small, but it is the hinge that turns value into an argument about status and order.

topics.headline: negation answers the counterfactual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second half of the conditional as a negated proof claim, not a separate sentence.
topics.reason: The particle begins the negated apodosis linked to the counterfactual protasis.

topics.headline: negation exposes social-order logic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation measures truth by whether the deniers were socially first.
topics.reason: The negated verb that follows makes precedence the deniers’ chosen evidence against goodness.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural precedence verb with a first-person plural object, claiming that others got ahead of us
words.root_gloss_range: preceding, getting ahead, racing, outstripping, and priority; locally a completed precedence claim with competitive pressure and a personalized object
words.prose: {{ar:سَبَقُونَا}} ({{tr:sabaqūnā}}) packs the polemic into one word: they got ahead of us. The plural subject is the believers, and the attached object makes the deniers’ wounded status explicit. The racing and precedence pressure turns truth into a destination reached first, so the argument measures guidance by who arrived before whom. That makes the otherwise positive race-to-good field feel inverted here into resentment over priority.

topics.headline: verb binds believers as subject and deniers as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the personal sting: the claim is not simply that believers came first, but that they came before us.
topics.reason: The attached first-person plural suffix is the direct object of the precedence verb, binding both groups in one form.

topics.headline: race image makes truth a reached endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deniers recast guidance as a race whose legitimacy depends on arriving ahead of the believers.
topics.reason: The local verb is followed by a goal phrase, licensing precedence and competitive outstripping pressure rather than an abstract status claim alone.

topics.headline: positive racing field is inverted polemically
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root often capable of positive hastening is here bent into resentment over priority.
topics.reason: The comparative rows link the root with positive hastening toward good (23:61, 21:101), while this ayah uses precedence polemically and anticipates the final priority word.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition plus pronoun marking the goal reached by the believers in the precedence claim
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}) supplies the destination for the race-like verb. The pronoun points back to the evaluated message, good, or way of response, and the preposition makes the deniers’ complaint directional: the believers got to it before us. The same referent will later return as the means through which guidance failed to occur.

topics.headline: direction phrase completes the race claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees truth or the message treated as a reachable endpoint in the deniers’ argument.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the pronoun the goal complement of the precedence verb, and the row family preserves the directional payoff.

topics.headline: same pronoun prepares the later instrument phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one referent moving from destination to means: first they were preceded to it, then they failed to be guided by it.
topics.reason: The same third-person masculine pronoun recurs later with a different preposition, supporting a local referent echo.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector shifting from the quoted argument to the narrator’s diagnostic clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) moves the ayah out of the deniers’ quote and into diagnosis. The connector keeps continuity with the reported speech while marking a change of voice: now the narration explains why their next accusation will follow. The scene is not merely continued; it is interpreted.

topics.headline: resumptive connector changes voice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah shift from what the deniers said to the narrator’s explanation of their failure.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a new temporal-causal clause after the completed quote, supporting the shift from reported speech to diagnosis.

words.gloss_range: temporal-causal particle meaning when or since, introducing the reason behind the predicted dismissal
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) fuses time and cause. It does not merely say when the deniers failed to be guided; it frames that failure as the reason the next speech act will happen. This particle is the diagnostic hinge between their earlier social argument and the later fabrication label.

topics.headline: when becomes since in the diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failure of guidance as the cause behind the accusation, not just its timing.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence describes the clause as temporal-causal, licensing both event-time and reason.

topics.headline: diagnostic particle prepares result chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can follow the logic from failure of guidance to the predicted saying that follows.
topics.reason: The temporal-causal clause is followed by a result particle and future speech verb, creating one cause-to-utterance chain.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator giving the following imperfect past negative force and marking failed guidance
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) governs the guidance verb and turns it into a past negation with final force. The denial is not that guidance has not yet happened in an open-ended way; in this diagnostic frame, they did not become guided by it. The particle prepares the causal result that follows.

topics.headline: negative particle controls jussive guidance verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guidance failure is grammatically marked as a completed negative diagnosis.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as governing the following jussive imperfect with past negative force.

topics.headline: negation blocks successful guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the later accusation as a symptom of failed orientation, not as evidence against the message.
topics.reason: The negation governs the guidance verb inside the diagnostic clause.

words.gloss_range: lam-governed Form VIII jussive meaning they did not become guided or find direction by the message
words.root_gloss_range: guidance, leading, showing the way, finding direction, and related gift or offering fields; locally Form VIII failed self-orientation is selected
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْتَدُوا۟}} ({{tr:yahtadū}}) names the real failure behind the speech: they did not find guidance by it. The Form VIII shape makes the failure reflexive or middle in feel, a failure to be oriented or find the way, while the instrument phrase keeps the message as the means. Broader gift-related pressure makes guidance feel received, but local grammar selects failed direction-finding.

topics.headline: jussive Form VIII marks failed self-orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the diagnosis as failed self-orientation under negation, not merely lack of information.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive after the negator, and Form VIII supports a middle or reflexive guidance profile.

topics.headline: omitted subject resumes the deniers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same denier group carried silently into the diagnosis and then into the future accusation.
topics.reason: The plural subject is not separately named because it is recovered from the preceding denier group.

topics.headline: path-finding pressure activates the instrument phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels guidance as direction found through a means, while broader gift or offering fields remain lexical pressure rather than the local sense.
topics.reason: The root supports direction, guidance, and gift-related associations; locally the negated Form VIII with an instrument phrase selects failed guidance by the message.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition plus pronoun marking the message as the means by which guidance should have occurred
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) changes the earlier pronoun’s role. What had been the destination of precedence now becomes the means of guidance, so the problem is not that the message lacked access; they failed to be guided by it. The compressed preposition-pronoun form keeps the same referent tight across the ayah.

topics.headline: preposition marks the message as means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the message is presented as a means of guidance, not merely an object of dispute.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the prepositional phrase as completing the failed guidance clause with instrumental force.

topics.headline: same pronoun shifts from goal to means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same referent moving from what others reached first to what the deniers failed to use for guidance.
topics.reason: The third-person pronoun echoes the earlier directional phrase, while the preposition changes its semantic role from goal to instrument.

words.gloss_range: result particle tying failed guidance to the predicted future accusation
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the next saying a consequence. The accusation is not presented as a fresh objection after reflection; it follows from not being guided by the message. The particle turns the diagnosis into prediction and keeps the causal chain visible.

topics.headline: result particle turns diagnosis into prediction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final accusation as the result of failed guidance, not as independent evidence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the following future speech clause as the result of the preceding guidance failure.

words.gloss_range: future plural speech verb predicting that the deniers will utter the closing accusation
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, utterance, and reported discourse; locally a future imperfect predicting recurrent dismissal
words.prose: {{ar:سَيَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:sayaqūlūna}}) returns to the speech root, but now as prediction. The stacked result and future marking fuses cause with what they will say, so the earlier completed report becomes a pattern of repeated dismissal. This future speech opens the final quotation and delivers the fabrication label as the expected outcome of failed guidance.

topics.headline: future form predicts the next utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing accusation as forecast speech, not merely a continuation of the first quote.
topics.reason: The future prefix on the imperfect and the plural ending keep the denier group as the predicted speakers.

topics.headline: result and futurity are fused before the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that cause and future saying arrive as one compact movement from diagnosis into quotation.
topics.reason: The result particle and future marker are attached to the speech verb that governs the final quoted nominal sentence.

topics.headline: speech root returns with fabrication label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the accusation as part of a speech-denial pattern that begins with past saying and ends in predicted repetition.
topics.reason: The same root bookends the ayah, and the future verb directly introduces the fabrication predicate; the same-surah false-speech pressure includes 46:22.

words.gloss_range: proximal demonstrative subject that points to the message and begins the final nominal classification
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَآ}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) makes the accusation point. The demonstrative starts a verbless classification, turning the already referenced message into the object placed under judgment. Because it is near deixis, the dismissal feels immediate: this, right here, is what they label as fabrication. The surah’s familiar pointer to the message is therefore turned into an accusation frame.

topics.headline: demonstrative begins the identity sentence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final claim as a classification of the message, not as a narrated event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies words 21-23 as the quoted nominal sentence governed by the future speech verb.

topics.headline: near demonstrative makes dismissal immediate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the message being pointed at directly before it receives the accusation label.
topics.reason: The demonstrative points to the same message referent already carried by the pronoun chain and places it before the predicate.

topics.headline: pointer continues the surah reference chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar demonstrative pointer is now turned into an accusation frame.
topics.reason: The row preserves a same-surah demonstrative-chain payoff without making it control the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: indefinite predicate noun meaning fabrication or lie, assigning a broad falsehood label without specifying an alleged fabricated detail
words.root_gloss_range: turning, overturning, inversion, and fabrication; locally an indefinite falsehood predicate whose root image makes lying feel like inversion
words.prose: {{ar:إِفْكٌۭ}} ({{tr:ifkun}}) is the core accusation noun. Its indefinite form gives a class label without naming any specific fabricated element, and its agreement with the following adjective binds fabrication and antiquity into one closing label. The root’s turning and overturning pressure makes the charge ironic: the deniers accuse the message of inversion while the ayah has exposed their own inverted standard of truth. Its marked falsehood register belongs to accusation speech, and its clipped three-consonant sound makes the label land abruptly.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate gives a vague falsehood label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is sweeping and unspecified, not a demonstrated falsehood.
topics.reason: The noun is the indefinite predicate of the demonstrative and controls the following adjective through agreement.

topics.headline: fabrication word carries overturning pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the lie label as a reversal-word, exposing the irony that the deniers’ own reasoning reverses guidance into blame.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports turning and overturning as semantic pressure under the local fabrication noun.

topics.headline: marked falsehood noun belongs to denial-speech field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the word as a concentrated falsehood register tied to accusation speech, not as a neutral description.
topics.reason: The comparative rows connect the word to slander and fabrication registers (24:11, 29:17), while local co-occurrence ties it to speech and denial.

topics.headline: clipped consonants sharpen the accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the accusation land abruptly at the center of the final nominal sentence.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows add a distinct sound-texture payoff that is not already covered by grammar or root semantics.

words.gloss_range: indefinite postposed adjective meaning ancient or old, sealing the fabrication label with temporal dismissal
words.root_gloss_range: foot, frontness, precedence, prior standing, oldness, antiquity, and advancing; locally an adjective of antiquity with priority pressure
words.prose: {{ar:قَدِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:qadīmun}}) is the final landing of the accusation. It agrees with the fabrication noun and stays indefinite, so the deniers do not name an old source; they use age as a distancing label. The root’s frontness and priority pressure echoes the earlier precedence verb, making the whole argument revolve around what comes first: they resent being preceded, then dismiss the message as already old. That misuse of priorness is answered by the next ayah’s prior-scripture witness (46:12).

topics.headline: postposed adjective seals the nominal accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes by qualifying the fabrication label, not by adding a new predicate.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the predicate noun in the final nominal sentence and closes the quotation with a matching indefinite cadence.

topics.headline: frontness and oldness echo precedence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word completing the ayah’s priority motif: who arrived first and what is called old become one logic.
topics.reason: The root supports foot, frontness, priorness, and antiquity; locally the adjective means old or ancient, while priority pressure links it to the earlier precedence verb.

topics.headline: oldness is used as distancing, not evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that antiquity is made into a dismissive label, even though priorness can also become corroborating evidence in the next ayah.
topics.reason: Local grammar makes the word an indefinite dismissive adjective; comparative rows such as 15:85 and 36:39 show old or remnant senses, and the next ayah answers the misuse of priorness with prior scripture witness (46:12).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual binds the value term at word 8 to being preceded at word 10 across the two named groups.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers make their own expected priority an admission test for value: a benefit that reached believers before them is treated as disqualified. Reception is therefore organized as a social race in which rank is presumed to control truth-access.

activation_trace.role: Contributes desirable benefit or advantage and supplies the value whose validity the speakers make socially conditional.
Contributes moving ahead in a contest or undertaking and converts reception into a ranking race.

changed_reading.before: The speakers deny that the message is good because believers accepted it first.
changed_reading.after: The utterance exposes an elite admission rule: value is certified by expected adopters and arrival order, so another group's precedence becomes a veto.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence moves from their failure to attain guidance by the object to their predictable future verdict on that same object.
baseline_models.mechanism: A failed relation is converted into an intrinsic defect: because the speakers do not arrive by means of it, they infer that it is displaced from truth. The falsehood label thus performs the very reversal it alleges, moving the explanatory burden from receiver to message and sealing the failure against correction.

activation_trace.role: Contributes gentle direction toward a true path and makes successful orientation the relation that has failed.
Contributes turning something away from its proper direction and functions as the speakers' causal inversion.
Contributes a lie displaced from truth and supplies the explicit content of the verdict.
Contributes a saying that circulates socially and turns private nonreception into a repeatable public account.
Contributes age from an earlier time and lets chronology harden the public verdict.

changed_reading.before: They fail to accept the message and consequently call it an old lie.
changed_reading.after: Their own non-arrival is made the premise of a self-protecting verdict: relational failure is reversed into alleged corruption of the guide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same verse joins another group's earlier arrival with the message's own age.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two temporal valuations collide. Priority is presumed valuable when the speakers imagine possessing it, becomes disqualifying when believers possess it, and becomes another disqualification when attributed to the message as age. The accusation manages a defeated claim to precedence rather than applying a stable rule about time.

activation_trace.role: Contributes prior advance and supplies the first temporal axis, the believers' earlier arrival.
Contributes prior standing or credit and allows age to carry a status-valence rather than chronology alone.
Contributes temporal oldness and supplies the second axis, the message's relation to an earlier time.

changed_reading.before: Ancient falsehood simply means a lie inherited from long ago.
changed_reading.after: The adjective closes a temporal knot: the speakers resent being late yet also weaponize the message's earliness, revealing that priority changes value with its owner.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of saying occurs at words 1 and 16, framing a present claim and a forecast future claim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first utterance installs a criterion, and the future utterance protects it after nonreception. Speech is not merely reported twice; it is a production loop in which a social maxim generates a doctrinal label, making the response predictable before further evidence arrives.

activation_trace.role: Contributes articulated speech and marks the two overt outputs of the loop.
Contributes speech as a held position and makes the repeated utterances outputs of an underlying doctrine of rank.
Contributes the final falsehood category into which the loop deposits the message.

changed_reading.before: The verse records two separate hostile remarks.
changed_reading.after: It reconstructs a predictable speech machine: a status premise, failed uptake, and a reusable falsehood label are successive outputs of one closed position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speaking and addressed groups are identified by the focus roots for disbelief and belief before their argument is quoted.
baseline_models.mechanism: The group labels also stage opposed epistemic postures. Covering and blocking truth stand over against settled trust and assent; the speakers then project displacement from truth onto the object trusted by the other group. The accusation is therefore relational boundary-work, not a neutral quality assessment.

activation_trace.role: Contributes covering and supplies an active posture of obscuring rather than a merely demographic label.
Contributes blockage of acknowledged truth and locates a possible obstacle in the judging group.
Contributes settled security and trust and supplies the contrasting receptive posture.
Contributes assent in which the heart comes to rest and marks the uptake the speakers devalue.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers and believers are labels for the two sides of an argument.
changed_reading.after: The labels enact the argument's epistemic asymmetry: an obscuring posture judges a trusting posture and transfers its own displacement onto the trusted object.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene supplies an informed witness to an analogous object, the witness's belief, and the audience's self-exaltation. The focus complaint about being preceded then reads as damage-control for rank: independent earlier uptake is potentially corroborative evidence, but is recoded as a defect because the wrong person arrived first.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the disputed benefit whose value is being filtered through social standing.
Supplies earlier arrival and receives a new role as corroboration that the speakers defensively invert.
Contributes testimony grounded in knowledge and makes the prior believer an evidentiary actor rather than merely an early adopter.
Contributes an analogous counterpart and links the witness's knowledge to the kind of object disputed in the focus.
Contributes settled assent and realizes the prior uptake that the focus speakers resent.
Contributes elevated rank and leadership and identifies prestige as the pressure behind rejection of the witness.

structural_cues: 46:10 immediately precedes the focus and orders knowledgeable testimony, belief, and self-exaltation before 46:11 turns earlier belief into a negative test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent witness, analogous object, belief, and self-exaltation; I infer that the precedence complaint protects rank against that scene. A live alternative is that 46:11 targets a general class prejudice rather than this witness in particular.

changed_reading.before: The speakers take earlier belief by others as evidence that the message lacks value.
changed_reading.after: Earlier belief has just appeared as informed corroboration; their counterfactual is a prestige-defense that reverses unwelcome evidence because its bearer outranks their permission structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence refuses novelty as a requirement, places an earlier book before the present one, and later describes a book after Moses as confirming what precedes it and guiding to truth. Age can therefore carry continuity, comparison, and confirmation. The focus adjective does not neutrally expose a stale source; it polemically reverses a potentially validating genealogy.

activation_trace.role: Contributes temporal oldness and supplies the feature whose evidentiary valence the context reverses.
Contributes origination without precedent and explicitly denies that unprecedented novelty is the messenger's claim.
Contributes temporal advance and places an earlier witness in a positive documentary chain.
Contributes an ordered written corpus and materially joins the earlier and present attestations.
Contributes soundness and settled validity and makes relation to the earlier book confirmatory rather than contaminating.
Contributes the later audience's recognition of the message as an ordered book within the same chain.
Contributes confirming soundness and makes backward relation an active test of validity.
Contributes direction to truth and shows that continuity and guidance coexist in the object called old in the focus.

structural_cues: 46:9 denies unprecedented novelty, 46:12 places an earlier book before the present book, and 46:30 calls a post-Mosaic book confirmatory of what precedes it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit precedence, book-relations, confirmation, and guidance; I infer that historical continuity is an alternative positive reading of age. The live alternative is that the focus adjective attacks only a recurrent lie and does not deny all precedent.

changed_reading.before: Calling the message ancient marks its age as evidence of falsehood.
changed_reading.after: The insult selectively flips a documented continuity: what can function as precedent and mutual confirmation is redescribed as stale fabrication.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier in the discourse the speakers are challenged to produce a prior book or surviving trace grounded in knowledge as proof of truth. The focus later dismisses the message through its age. Read together, antiquity is not an intrinsically invalid category; prior material is demanded when it might support the speakers and degraded when it supports the message.

activation_trace.role: Contributes relation to earlier time and becomes the selectively devalued property.
Contributes the falsehood verdict attached to age and supplies the negative half of the double standard.
Contributes prior temporal position and makes earlier evidence explicitly admissible in the challenge.
Contributes a surviving mark that indicates what once was and supplies durable evidence from the past.
Contributes disclosed knowledge and specifies the epistemic quality required of the prior trace.
Contributes settled soundness and makes the requested past evidence a proposed truth test.

structural_cues: 46:4's evidentiary imperative precedes the focus, although its immediate object is the speakers' rival cult claims rather than the message itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demand for prior knowledgeable evidence and a later age-based dismissal; I transfer the discourse's stated evidence rule across the two claims. A material alternative is that the rule is domain-specific, so the contrast need not be hypocrisy.

changed_reading.before: Ancient falsehood is an independent insult about the message's age.
changed_reading.after: It participates in selective antiquity: the past is welcomed as proof for inherited commitments but renamed falsehood when its traces challenge them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifest signs are called deceptive magic, the message is next called fabricated, the focus calls it old falsehood, and a later speaker calls the promise old tales. The labels move while rejection remains fixed. Their variation makes each label look like a substitutable defense generated after the stance rather than a stable diagnosis generated by evidence.

activation_trace.role: Contributes socially circulating speech and carries the focus label into a wider sequence of public formulas.
Contributes the focus falsehood label as one member of the mobile taxonomy.
Contributes manifest disclosure and supplies the evidentiary clarity that the first hostile label bypasses.
Contributes deceptive diversion and supplies the first replacement category for what has appeared clearly.
Contributes invented lying and supplies the next alternative label without changing the prior rejection.
Contributes false old tales and extends the same defensive taxonomy into a later generational dispute.

structural_cues: The accusation sequence at 46:7, 46:8, 46:11, and 46:17 changes predicates while preserving rejection and repeatedly uses a deictic target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct labels under a stable rejecting posture; I infer substitution because the categories change faster than the stance. A live alternative is that each label names a genuinely distinct objection rather than rhetorical mobility.

changed_reading.before: Old falsehood is the speakers' particular assessment of the message.
changed_reading.after: It is one interchangeable output in a mobile labeling practice whose fixed input is rejection, so lexical variety masks epistemic closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later address to the same rejecting group describes wholesome goods as already carried away in worldly life, enjoyed, and joined to self-exaltation. That materializes the focus criterion: the speakers may hear good as scarce, appropriable advantage whose value depends on reaching their group first. Their problem is not only a wrong answer about the message but a consumer-status model of value.

activation_trace.role: Contributes desirable benefit and receives a narrowed, socially appropriable sense from the later consumption scene.
Contributes passing away and makes worldly advantages benefits that can be used up and gone.
Contributes what is wholesome rather than corrupt and supplies the later category of valued goods.
Contributes pleasurable utility and turns value into immediate consumable enjoyment.
Contributes elevated rank and joins consumed advantage to the prestige logic already active in the focus.

structural_cues: 46:20 returns to the rejecting group and sequences exhausted worldly goods, enjoyment, and self-exaltation before judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later valued consumables and rank; I infer that this scene exposes the value-model behind the focus counterfactual. A live alternative is that the focus value term means truth or revelation without any consumer sense.

changed_reading.before: The speakers make a mistaken abstract judgment about whether revelation is good.
changed_reading.after: Their test treats good as a scarce status-benefit that should accrue to them first; the later scene exposes how such goods can be consumed while enduring value is missed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later audience is directed toward the recitation, listens with comprehension, calls for attentive silence, hears it through, recognizes guidance, and invites assent. This supplies the missing middle hidden by the focus speakers' inference. Guidance is encountered through an oriented reception process; failure at that process cannot by itself establish a defect in the guide.

activation_trace.role: Contributes direction toward path and truth and names the relation whose failed realization is under dispute.
Contributes redirection toward a face or destination and initiates the receptive trajectory.
Contributes understanding and responsive compliance, making listening more than acoustic exposure.
Contributes recitation and supplies the articulated object around which the listening process forms.
Contributes attentive silence and supplies a deliberate condition for reception.
Contributes recognized direction to truth and realizes what the focus speakers claim not to have found.
Contributes settled assent and marks the trajectory's invited response rather than a property forced by exposure.

structural_cues: 46:29-31 orders redirection, listening, silence, completion, communal report, recognized guidance, and invited assent; 46:10 separately links non-guidance with injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered listener process; I infer that receptive orientation mediates the guide's effect and that the focus suppresses this mediation. A live alternative is that guidance is primarily a divine grant, with listening as consequence rather than cause.

changed_reading.before: The speakers did not obtain guidance from the message, so they judged it false.
changed_reading.after: Their premise omits a reception trajectory that another audience enacts; non-guidance diagnoses a blocked relation at least as plausibly as a defective message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier people accuse a messenger of turning them away from inherited gods. Later those very helpers fail to aid, disappear from their users, and the support-system is named falsehood and fabrication. The focus accusation therefore participates in a reversible struggle over direction: the message is called the displacement, while the inherited apparatus that promised support is ultimately identified as displaced from truth.

activation_trace.role: Contributes turning away from a direction and supplies the focus speakers' accusation against the message.
Contributes attempted redirection from inherited objects and reveals what the hostile accusation protects.
Contributes aid that should make a protected relation effective and supplies the practical promise that fails.
Contributes loss of the supposed helpers and makes the support-system vanish under practical test.
Contributes falsehood displaced from truth and redirects the focus category onto the speakers' own apparatus.
Contributes invented lying and identifies fabrication as the process sustaining the failed helpers.

structural_cues: 46:22 directs the displacement accusation at the messenger, whereas 46:28 narratively assigns falsehood to the inherited helpers after their failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated displacement language, protected inherited objects, failed aid, loss, and fabrication; I infer a projection-like reversal in 46:11. A live alternative is that the repeated vocabulary is polemical symmetry without a psychological projection claim.

changed_reading.before: The speakers call the revelation an old lie that diverts people from truth.
changed_reading.after: Their label protects an inherited support-system and mirrors its own failure: what they call diversion is reorientation away from helpers whose promised aid disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: A destroyed predecessor community is described as more established than the present audience and as equipped with faculties that nevertheless did not benefit it. Material priority and capacity thus fail as certificates of discernment. The focus speakers' assumption that their group should have arrived first if the message were valuable belongs to the same unreliable status metric.

activation_trace.role: Contributes relative advancement and supplies the social priority claim tested by the predecessor comparison.
Contributes desirable benefit and supplies what superior capacity is wrongly expected to identify first.
Contributes effective empowerment and makes the earlier community materially superior to the current speakers.
Contributes understanding and compliance and highlights that an available faculty can remain practically unprofitable.

structural_cues: 46:26 explicitly compares the predecessor community's greater establishment with the current audience, then lists hearing, sight, and hearts that availed nothing amid denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparative empowerment and failed faculties; I infer that this undercuts the focus group's expectation of epistemic firstness. A live alternative is that material power and social precedence are separate metrics with only analogical force.

changed_reading.before: The speakers assume their standing would make them first to recognize anything truly valuable.
changed_reading.after: The historical comparison denies that capacity, establishment, or prior rank guarantees discernment; greater resources can coexist with a reception failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Soon after the focus, another saying is followed by sustained uprightness. That sequence contrasts with the focus sequence, where failed orientation is followed by another label. Speech is thereby tested by the trajectory it inaugurates: one utterance stabilizes conduct, while the other stabilizes avoidance.

activation_trace.role: Contributes speech as a held position and supplies the hostile position whose practical trajectory is examined.
Contributes an affair's direction, course, and conduct and links verbal position to subsequent orientation.
Contributes speech as conviction and supplies the contrasting utterance that is carried into action.
Contributes upright balance and makes stable conduct the test of the preceding saying.

structural_cues: The focus orders failed orientation then future saying, while 46:13 orders saying then continued uprightness through an explicit subsequent link.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two saying-to-trajectory sequences; I infer that their contrast evaluates speech by what it organizes afterward. A live alternative is that the passages describe unrelated groups without inviting a formal comparison.

changed_reading.before: The focus saying is wrong because its proposition is false.
changed_reading.after: Its deeper failure is performative: unlike committed speech that opens into upright conduct, it follows blocked orientation and organizes continued evasion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries an atmospheric reversal into an epistemic clause; it remains anchored by the focus deictic verdict, speech, and directional inversion while 46:24 stages confident misnaming under desire. Downstream prose should present it only as an illuminating analogy, not equate the message with the destructive storm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus speakers point to the message, say what it is, and classify it through a root of directional inversion.

activation_trace.role: Contributes a thing's apparent indication as a kind of saying and makes deictic classification an interpretive act.
Contributes reversal from proper direction and identifies the focus classification as potentially inverted.
Contributes an overt spoken classification and supplies the material scene's confident verbal verdict.
Contributes something appearing from a direction and supplies the visible form that is too quickly interpreted.
Contributes rain descending from cloud and supplies the desired benefit projected onto the appearance.
Contributes wind and supplies the materially different reality concealed by the desired classification.

changed_reading.before: The demonstrative introduces a straightforward hostile name for the message.
changed_reading.after: The demonstrative can mark a desire-driven perception event: like the visible cloud called welcome rain, the message is confidently named through the speakers' need before its reality is received.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because no literal wager is stated; it remains anchored in the explicit race-like precedence and disputed good. Downstream prose should call it a social-rivalry resonance, not claim that the verse describes an actual contest or stake.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus counterfactual makes the value of the good depend on which group has won temporal precedence.

activation_trace.role: Contributes the stake or prize attached to a race and recasts disputed good as value allocated by winning first place.
Contributes desirable benefit and supplies the prize-like value devalued once another group reaches it first.

changed_reading.before: Earlier adoption is used as an abstract argument against value.
changed_reading.after: The speakers behave as though truth were a wagered prize: once believers occupy first place, they protect status by declaring the prize worthless.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant split-root activation, not a claim about the ordinary morphology of saying; it remains worth carrying because the packet supplies the mapping and the surrounding verdicts visibly oscillate among magic, fabrication, and old falsehood. Downstream prose should mark it as branch resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled focus occurrence of saying frames a verdict that belongs to a visibly changing series of hostile classifications.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping contributes movement and lack of fixed position and recasts the doubled saying as unstable judgment.
The same instability resonance marks the magic verdict as one temporary position in the hostile taxonomy.
The repeated saying with a fabrication verdict supplies the visible movement from one classification to another.

changed_reading.before: The speakers consistently diagnose the message as false through several equivalent terms.
changed_reading.after: A split-root resonance foregrounds classificatory wobble: repeated saying keeps moving because no hostile label achieves a stable account of the object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the guidance root; it remains anchored in the explicit move from failed guidance to a future verbal verdict and is reinforced by the saying-as-conjecture branch. Downstream prose should describe an epistemic resonance, not derive the focus verb from the split root.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves directly from not attaining guidance to a forecast accusation without an intervening evidentiary test.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping contributes a suspicion pictured inwardly without settled verification and highlights what replaces attained direction.
Contributes saying that functions like conjecture and gives the unverified inward picture an overt future form.
Contributes impaired or misdirected judgment and relocates possible defect from the message to the appraisal.

changed_reading.before: The speakers reach a firm falsehood judgment after failing to find guidance.
changed_reading.after: The future verdict may expose an unstabilized suspicion masquerading as settled knowledge: conjectural speech fills the space where orientation failed.

strongest_changes: 46:10 turns another person's precedence from a supposed defeater into informed corroboration that the speakers reverse to protect rank.
46:9, 46:12, and 46:30 convert age from contamination into a chain of precedent, confirmation, and guidance.
46:22 and 46:28 reverse the falsehood accusation onto the inherited support-system whose promised aid disappears.
46:29-31 reconstruct guidance as an oriented listener trajectory, exposing the missing mediation in the focus speakers' self-sealing inference.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses a social race, a causal reversal, two incompatible uses of priority, and a predicted speech loop into one argument. The context repeatedly reruns those mechanisms with witnesses, books, consumed goods, failed helpers, and attentive nonhuman listeners, allowing several changed readings to coexist without selecting one.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact social referent of those who preceded remains open, so the 46:10 witness link is strong by adjacency but not forced.
The prior-evidence challenge in 46:4 concerns rival cult claims, so transferring its standard to the message remains abductive.
The material benefit scene in 46:20 may expose the focus speakers' value-model, but the focus value term can still denote truth or revelation without consumer coloring.
The non-dominant mappings for saying and guidance are deliberately retained as resonances and must not be presented as ordinary derivations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Social precedence misused as a truth test.** س ب ق B001 is preceding and racing ahead; خ ي ر B001 is what people incline toward as good, while ء م ن B002 is trusting assent. The deniers infer from others reaching belief first that the object cannot be good. The packet supplies sequence but not the value judgment; I infer that status rivalry supplies their causal arrow. `ما سبقونا إليه` therefore exposes a social-ranking criterion substituted for examination of the book.
2. **Failure to find a path becomes a charge that the path is crooked.** ه د ي B001 is gentle guidance toward a way or truth; ء ف ك B001 is turning something from its proper direction, and ق د م B003 is oldness. Because they do not travel by the guidance, they call it an old diversion. I infer defensive reversal: their failed orientation is projected onto the message. `إفك قديم` thus means not only an old lie but a long-standing alleged deviation from course.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:29–31 overturn the deniers’ prestige logic: a previously hidden audience hears later yet responds more quickly and carries the book onward. That later sequence confirms that temporal or social precedence cannot determine `خير`.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Good is reduced to a status race.** `خَيْرًا` activates خ ي ر B001, beneficial good, but also B003, selecting the better option; `سَبَقُونَا` activates س ب ق B001, racing or going ahead. The prior ayah placed a recognizing witness and arrogant rejecters before the same evidence; the following ayah presents an earlier book as guide and mercy. The packet gives independent criteria of likeness, confirmation, and benefit, yet the speakers substitute “who arrived first.” I infer that precedence is being used as a social proxy for value because accepting a lower-status group’s lead would revise rank. The conditional therefore exposes a competitive decision rule rather than an assessment of the message’s good.

2. **“Old falsehood” turns precedent against itself.** `إِفْكٌ` activates ء ف ك B001/B002, turning something from its direction and a lie diverted from truth; `قَدِيمٌ` activates ق د م B003, antiquity, while B002 supplies precedent standing or prior merit. In 46:9, non-novelty places the messenger in a valid sequence; in 46:12, an earlier book confirms the present one. The packet gives antiquity both as possible corroboration and as their dismissive label; I infer that `إِفْك` performs the turn by recoding continuity as discredit. The phrase reads as an inversion of precedent: what could establish lineage is redirected into a reason not to examine it.

3. **Failure to take the route generates a future doctrine.** `يَهْتَدُوا` anchors ه د ي B001/B002, accepting indication and taking a course; `فَسَيَقُولُونَ` can activate ق و ل B007/B013, circulating report and held doctrine. The causal order is explicit: they do not take guidance, then they will say the label. The packet supplies that sequence; I infer that the label stabilizes and publicly rationalizes a prior non-adoption. The ayah thus reads “old falsehood” as a downstream maintenance story, not as the evidentiary cause of rejection.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:12 immediately reclaimed precedence as corroboration, while 46:16 made a repeatedly announced future promise solid through ص د ق B002/B004. Together they exposed the temporal selectivity of 46:11’s label: the speakers treat the old as discrediting and decline a future whose truth is fulfillment, so ء ف ك B001 turns both directions of time away from evidence.

baseline.text: İnkâr edenler, inananlar hakkında, “İyi bir şey olsaydı onlar ona ulaşmakta bizi geçemezlerdi” dediler. Onunla doğru yolu bulamayınca da, “Bu eski bir yalandır” diyecekler.

findings.text: Başkalarının önce inanmış olması, mesajın iyiliğini ölçmek için toplumsal statü yarışına çevrilir; böylece kanıt yerine kimin öne geçtiği ölçüt olur.
“Eski yalan” nitelemesi, geçerli bir süreklilik işareti olabilecek önceliği incelememe gerekçesine çevirerek geçmişin kanıt değerini tersine döndürür.
Yalan etiketi, yol gösterme başarısızlığının sebebi değil, önceden verilmiş ret kararını sonradan açıklayan ve dolaşıma sokan bir öğretidir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A true communication leaves ordered, transmissible marks that can be read, witnessed, and followed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The branch images turn abstract proof into a material chain of stitching, inscription, landmarks, testimony, and tracked passage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Precedence is tested by traceable following
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A marked predecessor opens a path, later travelers follow it, and rival claims of precedence become visible as movement on that path.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Following or imitation (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); successive following (`quranic:root_000186:B001/m01`); gentle route guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); a forward race (`quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `تتلى عليهم آياتنا` (46:7), `أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي` (46:9), `سبقونا إليه` and `يهتدوا به` (46:11), and `من قبله كتاب موسى إماما` (46:12).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Moses' book, present revelation, and human response form a procession rather than isolated assertions; the issue is who follows an attested route and who merely claims to be ahead.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Falsehood is manufactured by joining or covering material, then maintained by redirecting perception and trapping inquiry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lexical branches materialize polemical labels as workshop operations and hunting techniques.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fabrication behaves like patched material
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Pieces are cut, joined, and presented as though the resulting artifact had an integral origin.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Hide cut for repair or stitching (`quranic:root_001150:B001/m01`); a destructive split (`quranic:root_001150:B002/m01`); a fabricated lie (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`); invented speech (`quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`); a made-up artifact (`quranic:root_001167:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `افتراه` and `افتريته` (46:8), `بدعا من الرسل` (46:9), `إفك قديم` (46:11), and `خلق السماوات والأرض` (46:3).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The accusation of invention is pressured by its own branch field: fabrication is a secondary craft of cutting and joining, unlike the originating act named nearby.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Falsehood is manufactured by joining or covering material, then maintained by redirecting perception and trapping inquiry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lexical branches materialize polemical labels as workshop operations and hunting techniques.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Denial works by covering and redirecting sight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An encountered disclosure is covered, turned aside, or made to appear in a displaced direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Directional reversal (`quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`); magic as perceptual diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`); physical covering (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); blockage of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); turning one's side away (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `سحر مبين` (46:7), `كفرتم به` (46:10), `إفك قديم` (46:11), and `وهم عما أنذروا معرضون` (46:3).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The opponents' labels describe a distortion in the message, while the branch pattern relocates the distortion into their own acts of covering and directional refusal.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözü sesle dışa çıkarılan ve harflerden oluşan sözlü ifade çekirdeğinde toplar; ad biçimleri de aynı alana bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözü sesli biçimde ortaya koyma ve ortaya konmuş sözlü ifade için genel başlık olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sesle dışa vurma ve sözlü ifade çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil bağlamında kişinin sözü sesli olarak ortaya koymasını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Fiilsel söyleme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ad bağlamında söylenmiş söz veya konuşma ürünü için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Söylenmiş ifade sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sözün sesle dışa vurulmasını ve söylenmiş ifadeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal konuşmayı sağlayan organ olan dili adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de konuşma alanına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Okur karışıklığı söz ile onu üreten organ arasındadır. Bu dalda ürün ve eylem merkezdir; komşuda bedensel araç merkezdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hem söyleme eylemini hem de söylenmiş söz adlarını kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun sallanmasına veya sarsılmasına neden olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel sarsılma alanı yakındır; bu kol hareket ettirme, sabit kalamama ve hareket sesini kurarken komşu kol farklı varlıklardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda ses, nesnenin kararsız hareketi ve sallanmasının sonucu olarak ortaya çıkar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insanda korku veya öfke yüzünden ortaya çıkan titremeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.
